findings.title: Signal has major reference plane gap
findings.description: Net /SPK_R has 7% reference plane coverage over 54.9mm of routing. Return current must detour around the gap, creating a loop antenna.
findings.recommendation: Route this signal to avoid ground plane gaps, or fill the void. On a 2-layer board the gaps are usually where back-side tracks cut the pour into islands — stitch the two pours together (draw-pcb stitch_zones) so return current has a way across. If a split is intentional, add a bridge capacitor across the gap.

findings.title: No EMC filtering near J2
findings.description: Connector J2 (IN L-G-R) has no ferrite bead, CM choke, or ESD protection within 25mm. Unfiltered I/O cables are the dominant source of radiated emissions — common-mode current as low as 5 µA can exceed FCC Class B.
findings.recommendation: Add a ferrite bead (e.g., BLM18AG601SN1D, 600Ω@100MHz) on signal lines near J2. Add ESD/TVS protection for external interfaces.
findings.summary: No EMC filtering near J2

findings.title: Board cavity resonance frequencies
findings.description: Board (100×83mm, εr=4.4) cavity resonances: (1,0) at 715 MHz; (0,1) at 861 MHz; (1,1) at 1119 MHz; (2,0) at 1429 MHz; (2,1) at 1669 MHz. PDN impedance spikes at these frequencies. Ensure adequate decoupling at and around these frequencies.
findings.recommendation: Add decoupling capacitors with SRF near these frequencies.
findings.summary: Board cavity resonance frequencies

findings.title: Missing stitching via at layer transition: Net-(JP10004-A)
findings.description: Net Net-(JP10004-A) has 2 layer transition(s) across B.Cu, F.Cu. 2 transition(s) have no ground stitching via within 1.0mm. The return current must find an alternate path, creating a loop antenna.
findings.recommendation: Add a ground stitching via within 1.0mm of each signal via. Place the ground via adjacent to the signal via on the same pad cluster.

findings.recommendation: Add a ground stitching via within 1.0mm of each signal via. Place the ground via adjacent to the signal via on the same pad cluster.
findings.summary: Missing stitching via at layer transition: Net-(JP20011-A)

top_issues.title: Signal has major reference plane gap
top_issues.description: Net /SPK_R has 7% reference plane coverage over 54.9mm of routing. Return current must detour around the gap, creating a loop antenna.
top_issues.recommendation: Route this signal to avoid ground plane gaps, or fill the void. On a 2-layer board the gaps are usually where back-side tracks cut the pour into islands — stitch the two pours together (draw-pcb stitch_zones) so return current has a way across. If a split is intentional, add a bridge capacitor across the gap.
